windows.title: A floor to return to
windows.description: The saved score gives pulse and bass the same narrow, forward direction while grain fragments occupy changing directions around them.

windows.title: When the floor dissolves
windows.description: The pulse role is absent here. A forty-pair grain cloud enters at 1:42.53, providing a contrast to the earlier rhythmic anchor.

scope: Four selected score roles; active events and reconstructed encoder directions. Other roles, effects, field energy, decoder and perceived localization are not drawn.
motionLaw: Native smoothstep u²(3−2u) in azimuth, elevation and half-opening; stereo azimuth offsets ±half-opening. First-order direction components are blended on the renderer’s 32-sample clock for display.

provenance.description: Encoder directions reconstructed from the matching saved score, native control records and renderer source. Not measured acoustic energy or perceived localization.
